thesis: This episode argues that while high-quality tech names like Amazon and Netflix have demonstrated strong pricing power and resilience over a decade, investors must remain aware of significant market corrections (20%+) and specific competitive threats, such as TikTok displacing long-form entertainment time. The speaker emphasizes a survey-based approach to assessing service quality and admits to past errors, noting that even the best companies have faced disruptions and that conflicts of interest should be managed by avoiding individual stock purchases.
